verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a 3D engine, since its Playground or editors could plausibly ship an AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no natural-language command interface. The llms.txt files only make the docs readable by LLMs, and the runtime probe finds no official MCP server and only a negligible community MCP repo, so there is no agentic path to operate the engine.
